import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

import type.Scope;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;

import org.bytedeco.javacpp.Pointer;
import org.bytedeco.javacpp.PointerPointer;

public class LLVMIRVisitor extends SysYParserBaseVisitor<LLVMValueRef> {
    // -------------------------- Visitor 相关 --------------------------
    private LLVMBasicBlockRef curBasicBlock = null; // 当前基本块

    // -------------------------- LLVM 相关 --------------------------
    // 初始化 LLVM
    public void init() {
        LLVMInitializeCore(LLVMGetGlobalPassRegistry());
        LLVMLinkInMCJIT();
        LLVMInitializeNativeAsmPrinter();
        LLVMInitializeNativeAsmParser();
        LLVMInitializeNativeTarget();
    }

    // 创建 module
    LLVMModuleRef module = LLVMModuleCreateWithName("module");

    // 初始化 IRBuilder，后续将使用这 个builder 去生成 LLVM IR
    LLVMBuilderRef builder = LLVMCreateBuilder();

    // 考虑到我们的语言中仅存在 int 一个基本类型，可以通过下面的语句为 LLVM 的 int 型重命名方便以后使用
    LLVMTypeRef i32Type = LLVMInt32Type();

    // -------------------------- 重写 visit 函数 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitFuncDef(SysYParser.FuncDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * funcDef
         * : funcType funcName L_PAREN funcFParams? R_PAREN block
         * ;
         */

        // 生成函数
        LLVMTypeRef returnType = i32Type; // 生成返回值类型
        PointerPointer<Pointer> argumentTypes = new PointerPointer<>(0); // 生成函数参数类型
        LLVMTypeRef ft = LLVMFunctionType(returnType, argumentTypes, 0, 0); // 生成函数类型
        LLVMValueRef function = LLVMAddFunction(module, ctx.funcName().getText(), ft); // 生成函数，即向之前创建的module中添加函数

        // 创建基本块并添加指令
        LLVMBasicBlockRef block = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(function, ctx.funcName().getText() + "Entry"); // 在函数中加入基本块
        addInstruction(block);
        visit(ctx.block());

        return function;
    }

    // -------------------------- Stmt 相关 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitReturnStmt(SysYParser.ReturnStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : RETURN exp? SEMICOLON # ReturnStmt
         * ;
         */

        if (ctx.exp() != null) {
            LLVMValueRef retValue = visit(ctx.exp());
            LLVMBuildRet(builder, retValue);
        } else {
            LLVMBuildRetVoid(builder);
        }
        return null;
    }

    // -------------------------- Exp 相关 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitNumberExp(SysYParser.NumberExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : number # NumberExp
         * ;
         */

        // 进制转换，并且配置整数常量 
        if (ctx.number() != null) {
            String number = ctx.number().INTEGER_CONST().getText();
            if (number.startsWith("0x") || number.startsWith("0X")) {
                return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number.substring(2), 16), 0);
            } else if (number.startsWith("0")) {
                return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number.substring(1), 8), 0);
            }
            return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number), 0);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitUnaryExp(SysYParser.UnaryExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : unaryOp exp # UnaryExp
         * ;
         */

        if (ctx.exp() != null) {
            if (ctx.unaryOp().PLUS() != null) { // 正号，没有作用，返回原本的值即可
                return visit(ctx.exp());
            } else if (ctx.unaryOp().MINUS() != null) { // 相反数，返回一个整数的相反数。这里为了后续计算，使用 0 减去原数
                LLVMValueRef expValue = visit(ctx.exp());
                // LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0) 生成一个整数常量 0，第一个参数是类型，第二个参数是值，第三个参数是是否是无符号数（0为无符号）
                return LLVMBuildSub(builder, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0), expValue, "minus");
            } else if (ctx.unaryOp().NOT() != null) { // 取反，非0值返回0，0值返回1
                LLVMValueRef expValue = visit(ctx.exp());
                // 这里首先 CMP 转化为 boolean 类型，之后通过 Xor 取反，最后扩展为 i32 类型
                LLVMValueRef _tmp = LLVMBuildICmp(builder,
                        LLVMIntNE, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0), expValue, "toBoolean");
                _tmp = LLVMBuildXor(builder, _tmp, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 1, 0), "getNot");
                return _tmp = LLVMBuildZExt(builder, _tmp, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitMulExp(SysYParser.MulExpContext ctx) {
        // 这里新添加 op 来区分是乘法、除法还是取模
        /*
         * exp
         * : exp op = (MUL | DIV | MOD) exp #MulExp
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.exp(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp(1));
        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.MUL:
                return LLVMBuildMul(builder, lhs, rhs, "mul");
            case SysYParser.DIV:
                return LLVMBuildSDiv(builder, lhs, rhs, "div");
            case SysYParser.MOD:
                return LLVMBuildSRem(builder, lhs, rhs, "mod");
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitPlusExp(SysYParser.PlusExpContext ctx) {
        // 这里新添加 op 来区分是加法还是减法
        /*
         * exp
         * : exp op = (PLUS | MINUS) exp #PlusExp
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.exp(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp(1));
        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.PLUS:
                return LLVMBuildAdd(builder, lhs, rhs, "add");
            case SysYParser.MINUS:
                return LLVMBuildSub(builder, lhs, rhs, "sub");
        }
        return visitChildren(ctx);
    }

    // -------------------------- 辅助函数 --------------------------
    private void addInstruction(LLVMBasicBlockRef block) {
        curBasicBlock = block;
        LLVMPositionBuilderAtEnd(builder, curBasicBlock); // 后续生成的指令将追加在 curBasicBlock 的后面
    }
}

翻译变量

我们需要做的，就是在翻译 main 函数之后增加翻译局部变量和全局变量的情况，实际上就是处理Store和Load语句。相较于上面的部分，我们新添加的就是对于 block 和变量的处理。对于block，添加了作用域的概念，这样就可以用Scope的isGlobalScope来区分全局和局部变量了。而对于变量，就是处理了varDef，AssignStmt，LValExp这些情况，使得全局变量可以直接进行load，而局部变量则是alloca -> store -> load操作。

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

import type.Scope;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;

import org.bytedeco.javacpp.Pointer;
import org.bytedeco.javacpp.PointerPointer;

public class LLVMIRVisitor extends SysYParserBaseVisitor<LLVMValueRef> {
    // -------------------------- Visitor 相关 --------------------------
    private LLVMBasicBlockRef curBasicBlock; // 当前基本块
    private Scope<LLVMValueRef> curScope; // 当前作用域

    LLVMIRVisitor() {
        this.curScope = new Scope<>();
    }

    // -------------------------- LLVM 相关 --------------------------
    // 初始化 LLVM
    public void init() {
        LLVMInitializeCore(LLVMGetGlobalPassRegistry());
        LLVMLinkInMCJIT();
        LLVMInitializeNativeAsmPrinter();
        LLVMInitializeNativeAsmParser();
        LLVMInitializeNativeTarget();
    }

    LLVMModuleRef module = LLVMModuleCreateWithName("module"); // 创建 module
    LLVMBuilderRef builder = LLVMCreateBuilder(); // 初始化 IRBuilder，后续将使用这 个builder 去生成 LLVM IR
    LLVMTypeRef i32Type = LLVMInt32Type(); // 为 LLVM 的 int 型重命名方便以后使用
    LLVMValueRef zero_i32 = LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0); // 生成一个整数常量 0，便于初始化

    // -------------------------- 重写 visit 函数 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitFuncDef(SysYParser.FuncDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * funcDef
         * : funcType funcName L_PAREN funcFParams? R_PAREN block
         * ;
         */

        // 生成函数
        LLVMTypeRef returnType = i32Type; // 生成返回值类型
        PointerPointer<Pointer> argumentTypes = new PointerPointer<>(0); // 生成函数参数类型
        LLVMTypeRef ft = LLVMFunctionType(returnType, argumentTypes, 0, 0); // 生成函数类型
        LLVMValueRef function = LLVMAddFunction(module, ctx.funcName().getText(), ft); // 生成函数，即向之前创建的module中添加函数

        // 创建基本块并添加指令
        LLVMBasicBlockRef block = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(function, ctx.funcName().getText() + "Entry"); // 在函数中加入基本块
        addInstruction(block);
        visit(ctx.block());

        return function;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitBlock(SysYParser.BlockContext ctx) {
        /*
         * block
         * : L_BRACE blockItem* R_BRACE
         * ;
         */

        // 进入新作用域
        Scope<LLVMValueRef> newscope = new Scope<>(curScope);
        curScope = newscope;

        // 依次 visit block 中的节点
        ctx.blockItem().forEach(this::visit);

        // 退出当前作用域
        curScope = curScope.getParentScope();
        return null;
    }

    // -------------------------- Stmt 相关 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitReturnStmt(SysYParser.ReturnStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : RETURN exp? SEMICOLON # ReturnStmt
         * ;
         */

        if (ctx.exp() != null) {
            LLVMValueRef retValue = visit(ctx.exp());
            LLVMBuildRet(builder, retValue);
        } else {
            LLVMBuildRetVoid(builder);
        }
        return null;
    }

    // -------------------------- Exp 相关 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitNestedExp(SysYParser.NestedExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : L_PAREN exp R_PAREN # NestedExp
         * ;
         */

        return visit(ctx.exp());
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitNumberExp(SysYParser.NumberExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : number # NumberExp
         * ;
         */

        // 进制转换，并且配置整数常量
        if (ctx.number() != null) {
            String number = ctx.number().INTEGER_CONST().getText();
            if (number.startsWith("0x") || number.startsWith("0X")) {
                return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number.substring(2), 16), 0);
            } else if (number.startsWith("0")) {
                return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number.substring(1), 8), 0);
            }
            return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number), 0);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitUnaryExp(SysYParser.UnaryExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : unaryOp exp # UnaryExp
         * ;
         */

        if (ctx.exp() != null) {
            if (ctx.unaryOp().PLUS() != null) { // 正号，没有作用，返回原本的值即可
                return visit(ctx.exp());
            } else if (ctx.unaryOp().MINUS() != null) { // 相反数，返回一个整数的相反数。这里为了后续计算，使用 0 减去原数
                LLVMValueRef expValue = visit(ctx.exp());
                // LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0) 生成一个整数常量 0，第一个参数是类型，第二个参数是值，第三个参数是是否是无符号数（0为无符号）
                return LLVMBuildSub(builder, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0), expValue, "minus");
            } else if (ctx.unaryOp().NOT() != null) { // 取反，非0值返回0，0值返回1
                LLVMValueRef expValue = visit(ctx.exp());
                // 这里首先 CMP 转化为 boolean 类型，之后通过 Xor 取反，最后扩展为 i32 类型
                LLVMValueRef _tmp = LLVMBuildICmp(builder,
                        LLVMIntNE, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0), expValue, "toBoolean");
                _tmp = LLVMBuildXor(builder, _tmp, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 1, 0), "getNot");
                return _tmp = LLVMBuildZExt(builder, _tmp, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitMulExp(SysYParser.MulExpContext ctx) {
        // 这里新添加 op 来区分是乘法、除法还是取模
        /*
         * exp
         * : exp op = (MUL | DIV | MOD) exp #MulExp
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.exp(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp(1));
        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.MUL:
                return LLVMBuildMul(builder, lhs, rhs, "mul");
            case SysYParser.DIV:
                return LLVMBuildSDiv(builder, lhs, rhs, "div");
            case SysYParser.MOD:
                return LLVMBuildSRem(builder, lhs, rhs, "mod");
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitPlusExp(SysYParser.PlusExpContext ctx) {
        // 这里新添加 op 来区分是加法还是减法
        /*
         * exp
         * : exp op = (PLUS | MINUS) exp #PlusExp
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.exp(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp(1));
        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.PLUS:
                return LLVMBuildAdd(builder, lhs, rhs, "add");
            case SysYParser.MINUS:
                return LLVMBuildSub(builder, lhs, rhs, "sub");
        }
        return visitChildren(ctx);
    }

    // -------------------------- Load 和 Store --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitVarDef(SysYParser.VarDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * varDef
         * : IDENT (L_BRACKT constExp R_BRACKT)*
         * | IDENT (L_BRACKT constExp R_BRACKT)* ASSIGN initVal
         * ;
         * 
         * initVal
         * : exp
         * | L_BRACE (initVal (COMMA initVal)*)? R_BRACE
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.IDENT().getText();
        if (curScope.isGlobalScope()) { // 全局变量
            LLVMValueRef globalVar = LLVMAddGlobal(module, i32Type, varName);
            LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, zero_i32); // 给全局变量初始化为 0
            if (ctx.initVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.initVal());
                LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, initVal); // 存在赋值，初始化为赋值常量
            }
            curScope.define(varName, globalVar);
        } else {
            // 局部变量，需要首先 alloca 开辟地址
            LLVMValueRef localVar = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, i32Type, varName);
            if (ctx.initVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.initVal());
                LLVMBuildStore(builder, initVal, localVar); // 局部变量，没有默认初始值，并且需要 store
            }
            curScope.define(varName, localVar);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitConstDef(SysYParser.ConstDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * constDef
         * : IDENT (L_BRACKT constExp R_BRACKT)* ASSIGN constInitVal
         * ;
         * 
         * constInitVal
         * : constExp
         * | L_BRACE (constInitVal (COMMA constInitVal)*)? R_BRACE
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.IDENT().getText();
        if (curScope.isGlobalScope()) { // 全局变量
            LLVMValueRef globalVar = LLVMAddGlobal(module, i32Type, varName);
            LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, zero_i32); // 给全局变量初始化为 0
            if (ctx.constInitVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.constInitVal());
                LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, initVal); // 存在赋值，初始化为赋值常量
            }
            curScope.define(varName, globalVar);
        } else {
            LLVMValueRef localVar = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, i32Type, varName);
            if (ctx.constInitVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.constInitVal());
                LLVMBuildStore(builder, initVal, localVar); // 局部变量，没有默认初始值，并且需要 store -> 左值赋值给右值
            }
            curScope.define(varName, localVar);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitAssignStmt(SysYParser.AssignStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : lVal ASSIGN exp SEMICOLON # AssignStmt
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.lVal().IDENT().getText();
        LLVMValueRef lhs = curScope.resolve(varName);
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp());
        // 对于赋值语句，需要 store 操作，加载右值到 alloca 开辟的空间中
        return LLVMBuildStore(builder, rhs, lhs);
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitLValExp(SysYParser.LValExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * lVal
         * : IDENT (L_BRACKT exp R_BRACKT)*
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.lVal().IDENT().getText();
        LLVMValueRef lhs = curScope.resolve(varName);
        // 对于左值，需要 load 操作，加载 alloca 开辟的空间中的值到新的变量中，满足 SSA 的要求
        return LLVMBuildLoad(builder, lhs, varName);
    }

    // -------------------------- 辅助函数 --------------------------
    private void addInstruction(LLVMBasicBlockRef block) {
        curBasicBlock = block;
        LLVMPositionBuilderAtEnd(builder, curBasicBlock); // 后续生成的指令将追加在 curBasicBlock 的后面
    }
}

  • 函数定义和调用：这里就是在visitBlock和visitCallExp中添加了对于函数参数和函数调用的处理，同时在visitFuncDef添加了对于 void 函数没有 return 语句的情况处理。
  • 流程控制：这里主要分为四个部分，if 语句，while 语句，break和continue语句，短路控制语句。针对这四种语句就是根据视频说的那样进行处理，具体代码罗列如下，也进行注释标识了。

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;
import org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM;

import type.Scope;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;

import org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTree;
import org.bytedeco.javacpp.Pointer;
import org.bytedeco.javacpp.PointerPointer;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;

import javax.sql.rowset.spi.SyncProvider;

public class LLVMIRVisitor extends SysYParserBaseVisitor<LLVMValueRef> {
    // -------------------------- Visitor 相关 --------------------------
    private LLVMBasicBlockRef curBasicBlock; // 当前基本块
    private Scope<LLVMValueRef> curScope; // 当前作用域
    private LLVMValueRef curFunction; // 当前函数
    private Deque<LLVMBasicBlockRef> breakLabels = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private Deque<LLVMBasicBlockRef> continueLabels = new ArrayDeque<>();    

    LLVMIRVisitor() {
        this.curScope = new Scope<>();
    }

    // -------------------------- LLVM 相关 --------------------------
    // 初始化 LLVM
    public void init() {
        LLVMInitializeCore(LLVMGetGlobalPassRegistry());
        LLVMLinkInMCJIT();
        LLVMInitializeNativeAsmPrinter();
        LLVMInitializeNativeAsmParser();
        LLVMInitializeNativeTarget();
    }

    LLVMModuleRef module = LLVMModuleCreateWithName("module"); // 创建 module
    LLVMBuilderRef builder = LLVMCreateBuilder(); // 初始化 IRBuilder，后续将使用这 个builder 去生成 LLVM IR
    LLVMTypeRef i32Type = LLVMInt32Type(); // 为 LLVM 的 int 型重命名方便以后使用
    LLVMTypeRef voidType = LLVMVoidType(); // 为 LLVM 的 void 型重命名方便以后使用
    LLVMValueRef zero_i32 = LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0); // 生成一个整数常量 0，便于初始化

    // -------------------------- 重写 visit 函数 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitFuncDef(SysYParser.FuncDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * funcDef
         * : funcType funcName L_PAREN funcFParams? R_PAREN block
         * ;
         */

        // 生成函数
        // 生成返回值类型 
        LLVMTypeRef returnType;   
        String retTypeStr = ctx.funcType().getText();
        if (retTypeStr.equals("int")) {
            returnType = i32Type;
        } else {
            returnType = voidType;
        }

        // 生成函数参数类型
        int paramCount = ctx.funcFParams() == null ? 0 : ctx.funcFParams().funcFParam().size();
        PointerPointer<Pointer> argumentTypes = new PointerPointer<>(paramCount);
        for(int i = 0 ; i < paramCount ; i++) {
            String argTypeStr = ctx.funcFParams().funcFParam(i).bType().getText();
            if (argTypeStr.equals("int")) {
                argumentTypes.put(i, i32Type);
            } else {
                argumentTypes.put(i, voidType);
            } 
        }
        LLVMTypeRef ft = LLVMFunctionType(returnType, argumentTypes, paramCount, 0); // 生成函数类型
        LLVMValueRef function = LLVMAddFunction(module, ctx.funcName().getText(), ft); // 生成函数，即向之前创建的module中添加函数
        curFunction = function; // 保存当前函数

        curScope.define(ctx.funcName().getText(), function); // 将函数名和函数对应起来

        // 创建基本块并添加指令
        LLVMBasicBlockRef block = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(function, ctx.funcName().getText() + "Entry"); // 在函数中加入基本块
        addInstruction(block);
        visit(ctx.block());

        // 解决 void 没有 return 语句的情况
        boolean flag = false;
        for (SysYParser.BlockItemContext blockItemContext : ctx.block().blockItem()) {
            if (blockItemContext.stmt() instanceof SysYParser.ReturnStmtContext) {
                flag = true;
            }
        }
        if (!flag) {
            LLVMBuildRetVoid(builder);
        }

        return function;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitBlock(SysYParser.BlockContext ctx) {
        /*
         * block
         * : L_BRACE blockItem* R_BRACE
         * ;
         */

        // 进入新作用域
        Scope<LLVMValueRef> newscope = new Scope<>(curScope);
        curScope = newscope;

        ParseTree parent = ctx.getParent();
        if (parent instanceof SysYParser.FuncDefContext) {
            SysYParser.FuncDefContext funcDef = (SysYParser.FuncDefContext) parent;

            // 解析函数参数，将函数参数也作为一个特殊的局部变量去翻译
            for (int i = 0; i < LLVMCountParams(curFunction); i++) {
                String paramNameStr = funcDef.funcFParams().funcFParam(i).IDENT().getText();
                String paramTypeStr = funcDef.funcFParams().funcFParam(i).bType().getText();
                LLVMTypeRef paramType = null;
                if(paramTypeStr.equals("int")) {
                    paramType = i32Type;
                } else {
                    paramType = voidType;
                }
                LLVMValueRef value = LLVMGetParam(curFunction, i);
                LLVMValueRef paramVar = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, paramType, paramNameStr);
                LLVMBuildStore(builder, value, paramVar);

                curScope.define(paramNameStr, paramVar);
            }
        }

        // 依次 visit block 中的节点
        ctx.blockItem().forEach(this::visit);

        // 退出当前作用域
        curScope = curScope.getParentScope();
        return null;
    }

    // -------------------------- Stmt 相关 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitReturnStmt(SysYParser.ReturnStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : RETURN exp? SEMICOLON # ReturnStmt
         * ;
         */

        if (ctx.exp() != null) {
            LLVMValueRef retValue = visit(ctx.exp());
            LLVMBuildRet(builder, retValue);
        } else {
            LLVMBuildRetVoid(builder);
        }
        return null;
    }

    // -------------------------- Exp 相关 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitNestedExp(SysYParser.NestedExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : L_PAREN exp R_PAREN # NestedExp
         * ;
         */

        return visit(ctx.exp());
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitNumberExp(SysYParser.NumberExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : number # NumberExp
         * ;
         */

        // 进制转换，并且配置整数常量
        if (ctx.number() != null) {
            String number = ctx.number().INTEGER_CONST().getText();
            if (number.startsWith("0x") || number.startsWith("0X")) {
                return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number.substring(2), 16), 0);
            } else if (number.startsWith("0") && number.length() > 1) {
                return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number.substring(1), 8), 0);
            }
            return LLVMConstInt(i32Type, Integer.parseInt(number), 0);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitUnaryExp(SysYParser.UnaryExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * : unaryOp exp # UnaryExp
         * ;
         */

        if (ctx.exp() != null) {
            if (ctx.unaryOp().PLUS() != null) { // 正号，没有作用，返回原本的值即可
                return visit(ctx.exp());
            } else if (ctx.unaryOp().MINUS() != null) { // 相反数，返回一个整数的相反数。这里为了后续计算，使用 0 减去原数
                LLVMValueRef expValue = visit(ctx.exp());
                // LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0) 生成一个整数常量 0，第一个参数是类型，第二个参数是值，第三个参数是是否是无符号数（0为无符号）
                return LLVMBuildSub(builder, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0), expValue, "minus");
            } else if (ctx.unaryOp().NOT() != null) { // 取反，非0值返回0，0值返回1
                LLVMValueRef expValue = visit(ctx.exp());
                // 这里首先 CMP 转化为 boolean 类型，之后通过 Xor 取反，最后扩展为 i32 类型
                LLVMValueRef _tmp = LLVMBuildICmp(builder,
                        LLVMIntNE, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 0, 0), expValue, "toBoolean");
                _tmp = LLVMBuildXor(builder, _tmp, LLVMConstInt(i32Type, 1, 0), "getNot");
                return _tmp = LLVMBuildZExt(builder, _tmp, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitMulExp(SysYParser.MulExpContext ctx) {
        // 这里新添加 op 来区分是乘法、除法还是取模
        /*
         * exp
         * : exp op = (MUL | DIV | MOD) exp #MulExp
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.exp(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp(1));
        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.MUL:
                return LLVMBuildMul(builder, lhs, rhs, "mul");
            case SysYParser.DIV:
                return LLVMBuildSDiv(builder, lhs, rhs, "div");
            case SysYParser.MOD:
                return LLVMBuildSRem(builder, lhs, rhs, "mod");
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitPlusExp(SysYParser.PlusExpContext ctx) {
        // 这里新添加 op 来区分是加法还是减法
        /*
         * exp
         * : exp op = (PLUS | MINUS) exp #PlusExp
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.exp(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp(1));
        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.PLUS:
                return LLVMBuildAdd(builder, lhs, rhs, "add");
            case SysYParser.MINUS:
                return LLVMBuildSub(builder, lhs, rhs, "sub");
        }
        return visitChildren(ctx);
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitCallExp(SysYParser.CallExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * exp
         * :  funcName L_PAREN funcRParams? R_PAREN     #CallExp
         * ;
         */

        String funcNameStr = ctx.funcName().getText();
        LLVMValueRef function =  curScope.resolve(funcNameStr);

        int paramCount = ctx.funcRParams() == null ? 0 : ctx.funcRParams().param().size();
        PointerPointer<Pointer> params = new PointerPointer<>(paramCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < paramCount; i++) {
            params.put(i, visit(ctx.funcRParams().param(i)));
        }

        LLVMTypeRef retType = LLVMGetReturnType(LLVMGetElementType(LLVMTypeOf(function)));
        // 这里进行判断预防 void 函数没有 return 的情况
        String retStr = LLVMGetTypeKind(retType) == LLVMVoidTypeKind ? "" : "returnValue";
        return LLVMBuildCall(builder, function, params, paramCount, retStr);
    }

    // -------------------------- Load 和 Store --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitVarDef(SysYParser.VarDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * varDef
         * : IDENT (L_BRACKT constExp R_BRACKT)*
         * | IDENT (L_BRACKT constExp R_BRACKT)* ASSIGN initVal
         * ;
         * 
         * initVal
         * : exp
         * | L_BRACE (initVal (COMMA initVal)*)? R_BRACE
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.IDENT().getText();
        if (curScope.isGlobalScope()) { // 全局变量
            LLVMValueRef globalVar = LLVMAddGlobal(module, i32Type, varName);
            LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, zero_i32); // 给全局变量初始化为 0
            if (ctx.initVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.initVal());
                LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, initVal); // 存在赋值，初始化为赋值常量
            }
            curScope.define(varName, globalVar);
        } else {
            // 局部变量，需要首先 alloca 开辟地址
            LLVMValueRef localVar = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, i32Type, varName);
            if (ctx.initVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.initVal());
                LLVMBuildStore(builder, initVal, localVar); // 局部变量，没有默认初始值，并且需要 store
            }
            curScope.define(varName, localVar);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitConstDef(SysYParser.ConstDefContext ctx) {
        /*
         * constDef
         * : IDENT (L_BRACKT constExp R_BRACKT)* ASSIGN constInitVal
         * ;
         * 
         * constInitVal
         * : constExp
         * | L_BRACE (constInitVal (COMMA constInitVal)*)? R_BRACE
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.IDENT().getText();
        if (curScope.isGlobalScope()) { // 全局变量
            LLVMValueRef globalVar = LLVMAddGlobal(module, i32Type, varName);
            LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, zero_i32); // 给全局变量初始化为 0
            if (ctx.constInitVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.constInitVal());
                LLVMSetInitializer(globalVar, initVal); // 存在赋值，初始化为赋值常量
            }
            curScope.define(varName, globalVar);
        } else {
            LLVMValueRef localVar = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, i32Type, varName);
            if (ctx.constInitVal() != null) {
                LLVMValueRef initVal = visit(ctx.constInitVal());
                LLVMBuildStore(builder, initVal, localVar); // 局部变量，没有默认初始值，并且需要 store -> 左值赋值给右值
            }
            curScope.define(varName, localVar);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitAssignStmt(SysYParser.AssignStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : lVal ASSIGN exp SEMICOLON # AssignStmt
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.lVal().IDENT().getText();
        LLVMValueRef lhs = curScope.resolve(varName);
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.exp());
        // 对于赋值语句，需要 store 操作，加载右值到 alloca 开辟的空间中
        return LLVMBuildStore(builder, rhs, lhs);
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitLValExp(SysYParser.LValExpContext ctx) {
        /*
         * lVal
         * : IDENT (L_BRACKT exp R_BRACKT)*
         * ;
         */

        String varName = ctx.lVal().IDENT().getText();
        LLVMValueRef lhs = curScope.resolve(varName);
        // 对于左值，需要 load 操作，加载 alloca 开辟的空间中的值到新的变量中，满足 SSA 的要求
        return LLVMBuildLoad(builder, lhs, varName);
    }

    // -------------------------- 流程控制 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitIfStmt(SysYParser.IfStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : IF exp THEN ifStmt = stmt (ELSE elseStmt = stmt)? # IfStmt
         * ;
         */

        // 生成条件
        LLVMValueRef condition = visit(ctx.cond());
        LLVMValueRef bool = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, condition, zero_i32, "IF");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef trueBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "IF_TRUE");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef falseBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "IF_FALSE");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef endBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "IF_END");

        // 生成分支
        LLVMBuildCondBr(builder, bool, trueBlock, falseBlock);

        // 处理 true 分支
        addInstruction(trueBlock);
        visit(ctx.ifStmt);
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, endBlock);

        // 处理 false 分支
        addInstruction(falseBlock);
        if (ctx.ELSE() != null) {
            visit(ctx.elseStmt);
        }
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, endBlock);

        // 处理结束
        addInstruction(endBlock);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitWhileStmt(SysYParser.WhileStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * WHILE L_PAREN cond R_PAREN stmt # WhileStmt
         */

        // 生成条件
        LLVMBasicBlockRef beginBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "WHILE_BEGIN");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef trueBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "WHILE_BODY");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef endBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "WHILE_END");

        // 进入循环
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, beginBlock);

        // 分支判断
        addInstruction(beginBlock);
        LLVMValueRef condition = visit(ctx.cond());
        LLVMValueRef bool = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, condition, zero_i32, "WHILE");
        LLVMBuildCondBr(builder, bool, trueBlock, endBlock);

        // 处理 true 分支
        addInstruction(trueBlock);
        breakLabels.push(endBlock);
        continueLabels.push(beginBlock);
        visit(ctx.stmt());
        breakLabels.pop();
        continueLabels.pop();
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, beginBlock);

        // 处理 false 分支
        addInstruction(endBlock);
        return null;
    }
    
    // -------------------------- break 和 continue --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitBreakStmt(SysYParser.BreakStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : BREAK SEMICOLON # BreakStmt
         * ;
         */

        LLVMBasicBlockRef breakBlock = breakLabels.peek();
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, breakBlock);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitContinueStmt(SysYParser.ContinueStmtContext ctx) {
        /*
         * stmt
         * : CONTINUE SEMICOLON # ContinueStmt
         * ;
         */

        LLVMBasicBlockRef continueBlock = continueLabels.peek();
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, continueBlock);
        return null;
    }   

    // -------------------------- 逻辑判断 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitCmpCond(SysYParser.CmpCondContext ctx) {
        /*
         * cond
         * : cond op = (LT | GT | LE | GE) cond        #CmpCond
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.cond(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.cond(1));
        LLVMValueRef condition = null;

        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.LT:
                condition = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntSLT, lhs, rhs, "LT");
                return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, condition, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            case SysYParser.GT:
                condition = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntSGT, lhs, rhs, "GT");
                return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, condition, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            case SysYParser.LE:
                condition = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntSLE, lhs, rhs, "LE");
                return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, condition, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            case SysYParser.GE:
                condition = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntSGE, lhs, rhs, "GE");
                return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, condition, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            default:
                break;
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitEqCond(SysYParser.EqCondContext ctx) {
        /*
         * cond
         * cond op = (EQ | NEQ) cond                 #EqCond   
         * ;
         */

        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.cond(0));
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.cond(1));
        LLVMValueRef condition = null;

        switch (ctx.op.getType()) {
            case SysYParser.EQ:
                condition = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntEQ, lhs, rhs, "EQ");
                return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, condition, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            case SysYParser.NEQ:
                condition = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, lhs, rhs, "NEQ");
                return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, condition, i32Type, "extend_i32");
            default:
                break;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // -------------------------- 短路求值 --------------------------
    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitAndCond(SysYParser.AndCondContext ctx) {
        /*
         * cond
         * : cond AND cond # AndCond
         */

        // 生成条件
        LLVMBasicBlockRef trueBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "AND_TRUE");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef falseBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "AND_FALSE");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef endBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "AND_END");
        LLVMValueRef addr = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, i32Type, "addr");

        // 左值判断
        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.cond(0));
        LLVMValueRef bool1 = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, lhs, zero_i32, "bool1");
        LLVMBuildCondBr(builder, bool1, trueBlock, falseBlock);

        // 左值为真，需要进行右值判断，存储右值结果
        addInstruction(trueBlock);
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.cond(1));
        LLVMBuildStore(builder, rhs, addr);
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, endBlock);

        // 左值为假，直接返回假，存储左值结果 
        addInstruction(falseBlock);
        LLVMBuildStore(builder, lhs, addr);
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, endBlock);

        // 根据存储的值判断
        addInstruction(endBlock);
        LLVMValueRef value = LLVMBuildLoad(builder, addr, "value");
        LLVMValueRef bool2 = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, value, zero_i32, "bool2");
        return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, bool2, i32Type, "extend_i32");
    }

    @Override
    public LLVMValueRef visitOrCond(SysYParser.OrCondContext ctx) {
        /*
         * cond
         * : cond OR cond # OrCond
         */

        // 生成条件
        LLVMBasicBlockRef trueBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "OR_TRUE");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef falseBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "OR_FALSE");
        LLVMBasicBlockRef endBlock = LLVMAppendBasicBlock(curFunction, "OR_END");
        LLVMValueRef addr = LLVMBuildAlloca(builder, i32Type, "addr");

        // 左值判断
        LLVMValueRef lhs = visit(ctx.cond(0));
        LLVMValueRef bool1 = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, lhs, zero_i32, "bool1");
        LLVMBuildCondBr(builder, bool1, trueBlock, falseBlock);

        // 左值为假，需要进行右值判断，存储右值结果
        addInstruction(falseBlock);
        LLVMValueRef rhs = visit(ctx.cond(1));
        LLVMBuildStore(builder, rhs, addr);
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, endBlock);

        // 左值为真，存储左值结果，直接返回真
        addInstruction(trueBlock);
        LLVMBuildStore(builder, lhs, addr);
        LLVMBuildBr(builder, endBlock);
        
        // 根据存储的值判断 
        addInstruction(endBlock);
        LLVMValueRef value = LLVMBuildLoad(builder, addr, "value");
        LLVMValueRef bool2 = LLVMBuildICmp(builder, LLVMIntNE, value, zero_i32, "bool2");        
        return LLVMBuildZExt(builder, bool2, i32Type, "extend_i32");
    }

    // -------------------------- 辅助函数 --------------------------
    private void addInstruction(LLVMBasicBlockRef block) {
        curBasicBlock = block;
        LLVMPositionBuilderAtEnd(builder, curBasicBlock); // 后续生成的指令将追加在 curBasicBlock 的后面
    }
}

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

import ra.*;
import utils.AssemblyBuilder;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;
import static utils.AssemblyBuilder.*; // able to use the constants and methods in AssemblyBuilder directly

import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.IOException;

public class RISCVGenerator {
    private AssemblyBuilder assemblyBuilder = new AssemblyBuilder();

    // Main entry point for assembly generation from an LLVM module.
    public void generateAssembly(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        generateTextSegmentAndFunctions(module);
    }

    // Generates the `.text` segment and processes functions in the LLVM module.
    private void generateTextSegmentAndFunctions(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        // Add the `.text` segment and the main function label.
        assemblyBuilder.addTextSegment();
        assemblyBuilder.addGlobalLabel("main");
        assemblyBuilder.addFunctionLabel("main");

        // Process each function in the module.
        for (LLVMValueRef function = LLVMGetFirstFunction(module); function != null; function = LLVMGetNextFunction(
                function)) {

            // Allocate stack space for the function.
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(INSTR_ADDI, REG_SP, REG_SP, "0");

            // Add the function label.
            assemblyBuilder.addFunctionEntryLabel(LLVMGetValueName(function).getString());

            // Process each basic block in the function.
            for (LLVMBasicBlockRef basicBlock = LLVMGetFirstBasicBlock(
                    function); basicBlock != null; basicBlock = LLVMGetNextBasicBlock(basicBlock)) {

                // Process each instruction in the basic block.
                for (LLVMValueRef instruction = LLVMGetFirstInstruction(
                        basicBlock); instruction != null; instruction = LLVMGetNextInstruction(instruction)) {
                    switch (LLVMGetInstructionOpcode(instruction)) {
                        case LLVMRet:
                            handleReturnInstruction(instruction);
                            break;
                        // Extend with other instruction handlers as needed
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Handles the return instruction in LLVM and generates corresponding assembly code.
    private void handleReturnInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction) {
        LLVMValueRef returnValue = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        String value = String.valueOf(LLVMConstIntGetSExtValue(returnValue));
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_A0, value);
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(INSTR_ADDI, REG_SP, REG_SP, "0");
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_A7, SYS_EXIT);
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction0(INSTR_ECALL);
    }


    // Outputs the generated assembly code to a specified file.
    public void writeToFile(String filePath) {
        String code = assemblyBuilder.getGeneratedCode();
        try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(filePath))) {
            writer.write(code);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

import ra.*;
import utils.AssemblyBuilder;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;
import static utils.AssemblyBuilder.*; // able to use the constants and methods in AssemblyBuilder directly

import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.IOException;

public class RISCVGenerator {
    private AssemblyBuilder assemblyBuilder = new AssemblyBuilder();

    // Main entry point for assembly generation from an LLVM module.
    public void generateAssembly(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        generateGlobalVariables(module);
        generateTextSegmentAndFunctions(module);
    }

    // Processes global variables and generates corresponding assembly data segment.
    private void generateGlobalVariables(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        for (LLVMValueRef globalVar = LLVMGetFirstGlobal(module); globalVar != null; globalVar = LLVMGetNextGlobal(
                globalVar)) {

            String varName = LLVMGetValueName(globalVar).getString();
            String varValue = String.valueOf(LLVMConstIntGetSExtValue(LLVMGetInitializer(globalVar)));
            assemblyBuilder.addDataSegment(varName, varValue);
        }
    }

    // Generates the `.text` segment and processes functions in the LLVM module.
    private void generateTextSegmentAndFunctions(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        // Add the `.text` segment and the main function label.
        assemblyBuilder.addTextSegment();
        assemblyBuilder.addGlobalLabel("main");
        assemblyBuilder.addFunctionLabel("main");

        // Process each function in the module.
        for (LLVMValueRef function = LLVMGetFirstFunction(module); function != null; function = LLVMGetNextFunction(
                function)) {

            // Allocate stack space for the function.
            RegisterAllocator registerAllocator = new SimpleRegisterAllocator();
            int stackSize = registerAllocator.allocate(function);
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(INSTR_ADDI, REG_SP, REG_SP, String.valueOf(-stackSize));

            // Add the function label.
            assemblyBuilder.addFunctionEntryLabel(LLVMGetValueName(function).getString());

            // Process each basic block in the function.
            for (LLVMBasicBlockRef basicBlock = LLVMGetFirstBasicBlock(
                    function); basicBlock != null; basicBlock = LLVMGetNextBasicBlock(basicBlock)) {

                // Process each instruction in the basic block.
                for (LLVMValueRef instruction = LLVMGetFirstInstruction(
                        basicBlock); instruction != null; instruction = LLVMGetNextInstruction(instruction)) {
                    switch (LLVMGetInstructionOpcode(instruction)) {
                        case LLVMRet:
                            handleReturnInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, stackSize);
                            break;
                        case LLVMAdd:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_ADD);
                            break;
                        case LLVMSub:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_SUB);
                            break;
                        case LLVMMul:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_MUL);
                            break;
                        case LLVMSDiv:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_DIV);
                            break;
                        case LLVMSRem:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_REM);
                            break;
                        // Arithmetic must precede store and load because they are in arithmetic
                        case LLVMStore:
                            handleStoreInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator);
                            break;
                        case LLVMLoad:
                            handleLoadInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator);
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Handles the return instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleReturnInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator, int stackSize) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction: ret i32 %add8
         * instruction: ret i32 13
         * 
         * returnValue: %add8 = add i32 %add6, %d7
         * returnValue: i32 13
         */
        LLVMValueRef returnValue = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        OperandLocation operandLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(returnValue);
        if (operandLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_A0, REG_SP, operandLocation.getData());
        } else if (operandLocation.isImmediate()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_A0, operandLocation.getData());
        }

        // Restore the stack frame and exit the program.
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(INSTR_ADDI, REG_SP, REG_SP, String.valueOf(stackSize));
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_A7, SYS_EXIT);
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction0(INSTR_ECALL);
    }

    // Handles the store instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleStoreInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction: store i32 123, i32* %c, align 4
         * 
         * source: i32 3 destination: %c = alloca i32, align 4
         * source: %add2 = add i32 %add, 1 destination: @b = global i32 0
         */
        LLVMValueRef source = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        LLVMValueRef destination = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 1);

        OperandLocation sourceLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(source);
        OperandLocation destinationLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(destination);

        if (sourceLocation.isImmediate()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_T0, sourceLocation.getData());
        } else if (sourceLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_SP, sourceLocation.getData());
        }

        if (destinationLocation.isGlobal()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LA, REG_T1, destinationLocation.getData());
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(REG_T0, REG_T1, "0");
        } else if (destinationLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(REG_T0, REG_SP, destinationLocation.getData());
        }
    }

    // Handles the load instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleLoadInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction: %c1 = load i32, i32* %c, align 4
         * 
         * source: %c = alloca i32, align 4
         * source: @a = global i32 1
         * source: %d = alloca i32, align 4
         */
        LLVMValueRef source = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);

        OperandLocation sourceLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(source);
        OperandLocation instructionLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(instruction);

        if (sourceLocation.isGlobal()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LA, REG_T1, sourceLocation.getData());
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_T1, "0");
        } else if (sourceLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_SP, sourceLocation.getData());
        }

        if (instructionLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(REG_T0, REG_SP, instructionLocation.getData());
        }
    }

    // Handles the arithmetical instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleArithmeticalInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator,
            String operand) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction %add = add i32 %c1, %a
         * 
         * source %c1 = load i32, i32* %c, align 4
         * source %add = add i32 %c1, %a
         * 
         * destination %a = load i32, i32* @a, align 4
         * destinationi32 1
         */
        LLVMValueRef source = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        LLVMValueRef destination = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 1);
        
        OperandLocation sourceLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(source);
        OperandLocation destinationLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(destination);
        OperandLocation instructionLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(instruction);

        if (sourceLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_SP, sourceLocation.getData());
        } 

        if (destinationLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T1, REG_SP, destinationLocation.getData());
        } else if (destinationLocation.isImmediate()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_T1, destinationLocation.getData());
        }

        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(operand, REG_T0, REG_T0, REG_T1);

        if (instructionLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(REG_T0, REG_SP, instructionLocation.getData());
        }

    }

    // Outputs the generated assembly code to a specified file.
    public void writeToFile(String filePath) {
        String code = assemblyBuilder.getGeneratedCode();
        try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(filePath))) {
            writer.write(code);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

SimpleRegisterAllocator.java如下图所示，它没有寄存器的分配算法，而是把所有的变量都放在栈上，在用到它的时候使用 load 指令加载到寄存器，如果它的值有更新，那么就使用 store 指令写入它的内存。allocate就是将operand都检索出来，之后统计个数，开辟栈空间来逐一分配栈空间。

package ra;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;

import java.util.*;

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

public class SimpleRegisterAllocator implements RegisterAllocator {
    // Map of variable to its location
    private final Map<LLVMValueRef, OperandLocation> variableLocations = new HashMap<>();

    @Override
    public int allocate(LLVMValueRef function) {
        // Set of unique variables in the function
        // and LinkedHashSet ensure the insertion order is the same
        Set<LLVMValueRef> uniqueVariables = new LinkedHashSet<>();

        // Traverse each basic block in the function
        for (LLVMBasicBlockRef basicBlock = LLVMGetFirstBasicBlock(
                function); basicBlock != null; basicBlock = LLVMGetNextBasicBlock(basicBlock)) {
                    
            // Traverse each instruction in the basic block
            for (LLVMValueRef instruction = LLVMGetFirstInstruction(
                    basicBlock); instruction != null; instruction = LLVMGetNextInstruction(instruction)) {
                // Get the operands of the instruction
                List<LLVMValueRef> operands = new ArrayList<>();
                // not itself, the number of INT Variable is correct
                // operands.add(instruction);

                int numOperands = LLVMGetNumOperands(instruction);
                for (int i = 0; i < numOperands; i++) {
                    operands.add(LLVMGetOperand(instruction, i));
                }

                // Add the operands to the set of unique variables
                for (LLVMValueRef operand : operands) {
                    String operandName = LLVMGetValueName(operand).toString();
                    if (operandName.isEmpty() || LLVMIsAGlobalValue(operand) != null
                            || LLVMIsAConstantInt(operand) != null) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    uniqueVariables.add(operand);
                }
            }
        }

        // the stack pointer is always kept 16-byte aligned.
        int offset = (uniqueVariables.size() * 4 + 15) & ~15;

        // Assign memory offsets to the unique variables
        for (LLVMValueRef llvmValueRef : uniqueVariables) {
            offset -= 4;
            // To ensure the same stack allocation as in the example
            variableLocations.put(llvmValueRef, OperandLocation.fromMemoryOffset(offset));            
        }
        
        // return uniqueVariables.size() * 4;
        return (uniqueVariables.size() * 4 + 15) & ~15;
    }

    @Override
    public OperandLocation resolveOperand(LLVMValueRef operand) {
        // Resolve the operand to its location
        if (LLVMIsAGlobalValue(operand) != null) {
            return OperandLocation.fromGlobalVariable(LLVMGetValueName(operand).getString());
        }
        if (LLVMIsAConstantInt(operand) != null) {
            return OperandLocation.fromImmediateValue(LLVMConstIntGetSExtValue(operand));
        }
        return variableLocations.get(operand);
    }
}

线性扫描寄存器分配算法

使用这个寄存器分配算法主要更改了两个类，一个是LineScanRegisterAllocator.java类，一个是RISCVGenerator.java类。前者就是线性扫描寄存器分配算法的实现类，后者如之前所说，为汇编代码生成的类。

LineScanRegisterAllocator.java类如下所示。主要就是根据 视频 来进行学习，或者直接看 论文。这里主要通过allocate来实现总体的算法框架，首先使用liveVarAnalysis来对于活跃变量的区间进行分析，之后通过区间起始点来对活跃变量处理之后的不同区间进行排序，然后对于每一个区间，都进行expire和spill来对旧的区间和溢出的区间进行处理，由此实现了线性扫描寄存器分配。

package ra;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;
import static utils.AssemblyBuilder.*;
import java.util.*;

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

public class LineScanRegisterAllocator implements RegisterAllocator {

    private final Map<LLVMValueRef, OperandLocation> variableLocations = new HashMap<>();
    // The interval of the variable
    private final Map<LLVMValueRef, Interval> variableInterval = new HashMap<>();
    // The active interval
    private final TreeSet<Interval> activeInterval = new TreeSet<>(Comparator
        .comparingInt(Interval::getEndPoint)
        .thenComparingInt(Interval::getStartPoint)
        .thenComparingInt(i -> i.getLLVMValueRef().hashCode())
        );

    private int stackSize = 0;
    // The free register pool
    private final Deque<String> freeRegPool = new ArrayDeque<>(Arrays.asList(
            REG_T2, REG_T3, REG_T4, REG_T5, REG_T6,
            REG_S0, REG_S1, REG_S2, REG_S3, REG_S4, REG_S5, REG_S6, REG_S7, REG_S8, REG_S9, REG_S10, REG_S11,
            REG_A1, REG_A2, REG_A3, REG_A4, REG_A5, REG_A6)); // Reserved Registers: t0, t1, a0, a7 and other regs.

    private final int registerPoolLimit = freeRegPool.size();

    @Override
    public int allocate(LLVMValueRef function) {
        // analysis active variable to get the interval
        liveVarAnalysis(function);

        // Sort the intervals by the start point
        List<Interval> sortedIntervals = new ArrayList<>(variableInterval.values());
        sortedIntervals.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(Interval::getStartPoint));

        // Allocate the register bypass line scan algorithm
        for (Interval interval : sortedIntervals) {
            // Expire the old interval
            expireOldInterval(interval);
            // If the active interval is full, spill the interval
            if (activeInterval.size() == registerPoolLimit) {
                spillAtInterval(interval);
            } else { // Otherwise, allocate the register
                OperandLocation operandLocation = OperandLocation.fromRegisterVariable(freeRegPool.pop());
                variableLocations.put(interval.getLLVMValueRef(), operandLocation);
                activeInterval.add(interval);
            }
        }
        return stackSize;
    }

    @Override
    public OperandLocation resolveOperand(LLVMValueRef operand) {
        // Resolve the operand to its location
        if (LLVMIsAGlobalValue(operand) != null) {
            return OperandLocation.fromGlobalVariable(LLVMGetValueName(operand).getString());
        }
        if (LLVMIsAConstantInt(operand) != null) {
            return OperandLocation.fromImmediateValue(LLVMConstIntGetSExtValue(operand));
        }
        return variableLocations.get(operand);
    }

    // active variable analysis
    private void liveVarAnalysis(LLVMValueRef function) {
        // record the current command position
        int point = 0;

        // Traverse each basic block in the function
        for (LLVMBasicBlockRef basicBlock = LLVMGetFirstBasicBlock(
                function); basicBlock != null; basicBlock = LLVMGetNextBasicBlock(basicBlock)) {

            // Traverse each instruction in the basic block
            for (LLVMValueRef instruction = LLVMGetFirstInstruction(
                    basicBlock); instruction != null; instruction = LLVMGetNextInstruction(instruction)) {

                // Get the operands of the instruction
                List<LLVMValueRef> operands = new ArrayList<>();
                // To set up the point, there need instruction
                // If not, a null pointer error will be reported.
                operands.add(instruction);

                int numOperands = LLVMGetNumOperands(instruction);
                for (int i = 0; i < numOperands; i++) {
                    operands.add(LLVMGetOperand(instruction, i));
                }

                // Add the operands to the map of variableInterval
                for (LLVMValueRef operand : operands) {
                    String operandName = LLVMGetValueName(operand).getString();
                    if (operandName.isEmpty() || LLVMIsAGlobalValue(operand) != null
                            || LLVMIsAConstantInt(operand) != null) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    // If the variable is not in the map, add it to the map
                    // Otherwise, update the end point of the interval
                    if (variableInterval.containsKey(operand)) {
                        variableInterval.get(operand).setEndPoint(point);
                    } else {
                        variableInterval.put(operand, new Interval(point, point, operand));
                    }
                }
                ++point;
            }
        }
    }

    private void expireOldInterval(Interval curInterval) {
        Iterator<Interval> iterator = activeInterval.iterator();
        // Expire the old interval
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            Interval interval = iterator.next();
            // If the end point of the interval is greater than the start point of the current interval
            if (interval.getEndPoint() >= curInterval.getStartPoint()) {
                break;
            }
            iterator.remove();
            freeRegPool.push(variableLocations.get(interval.getLLVMValueRef()).getData());
        }
    }

    private void spillAtInterval(Interval curInterval) {
        // Find the interval with the latest end point
        Interval spill = activeInterval.last();
        // If the end point of the spill interval is greater than the end point of the current interval
        // Spill the interval
        if (spill.getEndPoint() > curInterval.getEndPoint()) {
            variableLocations.put(curInterval.getLLVMValueRef(), variableLocations.get(spill.getLLVMValueRef()));
            variableLocations.put(spill.getLLVMValueRef(), OperandLocation.fromMemoryOffset(stackSize));
            activeInterval.pollLast();
            activeInterval.add(curInterval);
        } else { // Otherwise, spill the current interval
            variableLocations.put(curInterval.getLLVMValueRef(), OperandLocation.fromMemoryOffset(stackSize));
        }
        stackSize += 4;
    }
}

RISCVGenerator.java如下所示。对于这个类，我们的更改就是添加了mv这个指令。而为了添加这个指令，我们就需要完成对于寄存器的转换，所以在对于不同语句的处理中添加了location isRegister和reg =两种情况，它们是互相配对的，后者在前面完成了寄存器的转移，前者就又赋值回去，正是它们的存在才能体现出使用了多个寄存器，不然始终就是T0和T1了。对于 reg 的分配，只需要和原本分配的寄存器相对应就可以了。这里从freeRegPool拿出了A0、A7、T0、T1这几个特殊的寄存器，所以我们对于 reg 的赋值就是T0，T1和它被算法分配的寄存器这三个寄存器了，只需要在赋值的时候进行注意即可。

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.*;

import ra.*;
import utils.AssemblyBuilder;

import static org.bytedeco.llvm.global.LLVM.*;
import static utils.AssemblyBuilder.*; // able to use the constants and methods in AssemblyBuilder directly

import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.IOException;

public class RISCVGenerator {
    private AssemblyBuilder assemblyBuilder = new AssemblyBuilder();

    // Main entry point for assembly generation from an LLVM module.
    public void generateAssembly(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        generateGlobalVariables(module);
        generateTextSegmentAndFunctions(module);
    }

    // Processes global variables and generates corresponding assembly data segment.
    private void generateGlobalVariables(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        for (LLVMValueRef globalVar = LLVMGetFirstGlobal(module); globalVar != null; globalVar = LLVMGetNextGlobal(
                globalVar)) {

            String varName = LLVMGetValueName(globalVar).getString();
            String varValue = String.valueOf(LLVMConstIntGetSExtValue(LLVMGetInitializer(globalVar)));
            assemblyBuilder.addDataSegment(varName, varValue);
        }
    }

    // Generates the `.text` segment and processes functions in the LLVM module.
    private void generateTextSegmentAndFunctions(LLVMModuleRef module) {
        // Add the `.text` segment and the main function label.
        assemblyBuilder.addTextSegment();
        assemblyBuilder.addGlobalLabel("main");
        assemblyBuilder.addFunctionLabel("main");

        // Process each function in the module.
        for (LLVMValueRef function = LLVMGetFirstFunction(module); function != null; function = LLVMGetNextFunction(
                function)) {

            // Allocate stack space for the function.
            RegisterAllocator registerAllocator = new LineScanRegisterAllocator();
            int stackSize = registerAllocator.allocate(function);
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(INSTR_ADDI, REG_SP, REG_SP, String.valueOf(-stackSize));

            // Add the function label.
            assemblyBuilder.addFunctionEntryLabel(LLVMGetValueName(function).getString());

            // Process each basic block in the function.
            for (LLVMBasicBlockRef basicBlock = LLVMGetFirstBasicBlock(
                    function); basicBlock != null; basicBlock = LLVMGetNextBasicBlock(basicBlock)) {

                // Process each instruction in the basic block.
                for (LLVMValueRef instruction = LLVMGetFirstInstruction(
                        basicBlock); instruction != null; instruction = LLVMGetNextInstruction(instruction)) {
                    switch (LLVMGetInstructionOpcode(instruction)) {
                        case LLVMRet:
                            handleReturnInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, stackSize);
                            break;
                        case LLVMAdd:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_ADD);
                            break;
                        case LLVMSub:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_SUB);
                            break;
                        case LLVMMul:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_MUL);
                            break;
                        case LLVMSDiv:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_DIV);
                            break;
                        case LLVMSRem:
                            handleArithmeticalInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator, INSTR_REM);
                            break;
                        // Arithmetic must precede store and load because they are in arithmetic
                        case LLVMStore:
                            handleStoreInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator);
                            break;
                        case LLVMLoad:
                            handleLoadInstruction(instruction, registerAllocator);
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Handles the return instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleReturnInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator, int stackSize) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction: ret i32 %add8
         * instruction: ret i32 13
         * 
         * returnValue: %add8 = add i32 %add6, %d7
         * returnValue: i32 13
         */
        LLVMValueRef returnValue = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        OperandLocation operandLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(returnValue);

        if (operandLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_SP, operandLocation.getData());
        } else if (operandLocation.isImmediate()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_T0, operandLocation.getData());
        }

        String reg = operandLocation.isMemory() ? REG_T0
                : operandLocation.isImmediate() ? REG_T0 : operandLocation.getData();

        // Restore the stack frame and exit the program.
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(INSTR_ADDI, REG_SP, REG_SP, String.valueOf(stackSize));
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_MV, REG_A0, reg);
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_A7, SYS_EXIT);
        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction0(INSTR_ECALL);
    }

    // Handles the store instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleStoreInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction: store i32 123, i32* %c, align 4
         * 
         * source: i32 3 destination: %c = alloca i32, align 4
         * source: %add2 = add i32 %add, 1 destination: @b = global i32 0
         */
        LLVMValueRef source = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        LLVMValueRef destination = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 1);

        OperandLocation sourceLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(source);
        OperandLocation destinationLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(destination);

        if (sourceLocation.isImmediate()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_T0, sourceLocation.getData());
        } else if (sourceLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_SP, sourceLocation.getData());
        }
        
        String reg = sourceLocation.isImmediate() ? REG_T0
                : sourceLocation.isMemory() ? REG_T0 : sourceLocation.getData();

        if (destinationLocation.isGlobal()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LA, REG_T1, destinationLocation.getData());
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(reg, REG_T1, "0");
        } else if (destinationLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(reg, REG_SP, destinationLocation.getData());
        } else if(destinationLocation.isRegister()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_MV, destinationLocation.getData(), reg);
        }
    }

    // Handles the load instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleLoadInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction: %c1 = load i32, i32* %c, align 4
         * 
         * source: %c = alloca i32, align 4
         * source: @a = global i32 1
         * source: %d = alloca i32, align 4
         */
        LLVMValueRef source = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);

        OperandLocation sourceLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(source);
        OperandLocation instructionLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(instruction);

        String reg = instructionLocation.isMemory() ? REG_T0 : instructionLocation.getData();

        if (sourceLocation.isGlobal()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LA, REG_T1, sourceLocation.getData());
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(reg, REG_T1, "0");
        } else if (sourceLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(reg, REG_SP, sourceLocation.getData());
        } else if(sourceLocation.isRegister()){
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_MV, reg, sourceLocation.getData());
        }

        if (instructionLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(REG_T0, REG_SP, instructionLocation.getData());
        }
    }

    // Handles the arithmetical instruction in LLVM and generates assembly code.
    private void handleArithmeticalInstruction(LLVMValueRef instruction, RegisterAllocator registerAllocator,
            String operand) {
        /*
         * eg:
         * instruction %add = add i32 %c1, %a
         * 
         * source %c1 = load i32, i32* %c, align 4
         * source %add = add i32 %c1, %a
         * 
         * destination %a = load i32, i32* @a, align 4
         * destinationi32 1
         */
        LLVMValueRef source = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 0);
        LLVMValueRef destination = LLVMGetOperand(instruction, 1);

        OperandLocation sourceLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(source);
        OperandLocation destinationLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(destination);
        OperandLocation instructionLocation = registerAllocator.resolveOperand(instruction);

        if (sourceLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T0, REG_SP, sourceLocation.getData());
        }

        String sourceReg = sourceLocation.isMemory() ? REG_T0 : sourceLocation.getData();

        if (destinationLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionLoad(REG_T1, REG_SP, destinationLocation.getData());
        } else if (destinationLocation.isImmediate()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstruction2(INSTR_LI, REG_T1, destinationLocation.getData());
        }

        String destinationReg = destinationLocation.isMemory() ? REG_T1
                : destinationLocation.isImmediate() ? REG_T1 : destinationLocation.getData();

        String instructionReg = instructionLocation.isMemory() ? REG_T0 : instructionLocation.getData();

        assemblyBuilder.addInstruction3(operand, instructionReg, sourceReg, destinationReg);

        if (instructionLocation.isMemory()) {
            assemblyBuilder.addInstructionStore(REG_T0, REG_SP, instructionLocation.getData());
        }

    }

    // Outputs the generated assembly code to a specified file.
    public void writeToFile(String filePath) {
        String code = assemblyBuilder.getGeneratedCode();
        try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(filePath))) {
            writer.write(code);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

package utils;

public class AssemblyBuilder {
    private StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();

    // ---------------------------------- Registers and Instructions ----------------------------------
    public static final String REG_A0 = "a0";
    public static final String REG_A1 = "a1";
    public static final String REG_A2 = "a2";
    public static final String REG_A3 = "a3";
    public static final String REG_A4 = "a4";
    public static final String REG_A5 = "a5";
    public static final String REG_A6 = "a6";
    public static final String REG_A7 = "a7";
    public static final String REG_T0 = "t0";
    public static final String REG_T1 = "t1";
    public static final String REG_T2 = "t2";
    public static final String REG_T3 = "t3";
    public static final String REG_T4 = "t4";
    public static final String REG_T5 = "t5";
    public static final String REG_T6 = "t6";
    public static final String REG_S0 = "s0";
    public static final String REG_S1 = "s1";
    public static final String REG_S2 = "s2";
    public static final String REG_S3 = "s3";
    public static final String REG_S4 = "s4";
    public static final String REG_S5 = "s5";
    public static final String REG_S6 = "s6";
    public static final String REG_S7 = "s7";
    public static final String REG_S8 = "s8";
    public static final String REG_S9 = "s9";
    public static final String REG_S10 = "s10";
    public static final String REG_S11 = "s11";
    public static final String REG_GP = "gp";
    public static final String REG_SP = "sp";
    public static final String REG_FP = "fp";
    public static final String REG_RA = "ra";
    public static final String REG_ZERO = "zero";
    public static final String INSTR_ADDI = "addi";
    public static final String INSTR_ADD = "add";
    public static final String INSTR_SUB = "sub";
    public static final String INSTR_MUL = "mul";
    public static final String INSTR_DIV = "div";
    public static final String INSTR_REM = "rem";
    public static final String INSTR_LI = "li";
    public static final String INSTR_LA = "la";
    public static final String INSTR_MV = "mv";
    public static final String INSTR_ECALL = "ecall";

    public static String SYS_EXIT = "93";
    
    // ---------------------------------- Segment and Label Handling ----------------------------------

    // Adds a `.data` segment with a variable declaration.
    public void addDataSegment(String varName, String varValue) {
        buffer.append("\n  .data\n");
        buffer.append(String.format("%s:\n  .word %s\n", varName, varValue));
    }

    // Adds a `.text` segment declaration.
    public void addTextSegment() {
        buffer.append("\n  .text\n");
    }

    // Adds a global label.
    public void addGlobalLabel(String label) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  .globl %s\n", label));
    }

    // Adds a function label.
    public void addFunctionLabel(String label) {
        buffer.append(String.format("%s:\n", label));
    }

    // Adds a function label.
    public void addFunctionEntryLabel(String label) {
        buffer.append(String.format("%sEntry:\n", label));
    }

    // ---------------------------------- Instruction Handling ----------------------------------

    // Adds an instruction with no operands.
    public void addInstruction0(String instruction) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  %s\n", instruction));
    }

    // Adds an instruction with one operand.
    public void addInstruction1(String instruction, String dest) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  %s %s\n", instruction, dest));
    }

    // Adds an instruction with two operand.
    public void addInstruction2(String instruction, String dest, String src) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  %s %s, %s\n", instruction, dest, src));
    }

    // Adds an instruction with three operands.
    public void addInstruction3(String instruction, String dest, String lhs, String rhs) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  %s %s, %s, %s\n", instruction, dest, lhs, rhs));
    }

    // Adds an instruction to load a value into a register.
    public void addInstructionLoad(String reg, String base, String offset) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  lw %s, %s(%s)\n", reg, offset, base));
    }

    // Adds an instruction to store a value into a memory location.
    public void addInstructionStore(String reg, String base, String offset) {
        buffer.append(String.format("  sw %s, %s(%s)\n", reg, offset, base));
    }


    // ---------------------------------- Code Retrieval ----------------------------------
    // Retrieves the generated assembly code.
    public String getGeneratedCode() {
        return buffer.toString();
    }
}

package ra;

public class OperandLocation {
    private enum LocationType {
        MEMORY, // Memory location
        IMMEDIATE, // Immediate value
        GLOBAL, // Global variable
        REGISTER // Register variable 
    }
    
    private final LocationType type; // The type of this location
    private final String data; // The data associated with the location

    private OperandLocation(LocationType type, String data) {
        this.type = type;
        this.data = data;
    }

    // Get the associated data
    public String getData() {
        return data;
    }

    // Factory method to create a memory location
    public static OperandLocation fromMemoryOffset(int offset) {
        return new OperandLocation(LocationType.MEMORY, String.valueOf(offset));
    }

    // Factory method to create an immediate value location
    public static OperandLocation fromImmediateValue(long value) {
        return new OperandLocation(LocationType.IMMEDIATE, String.valueOf(value));
    }

    // Factory method to create a global variable location
    public static OperandLocation fromGlobalVariable(String name) {
        return new OperandLocation(LocationType.GLOBAL, name);
    }

    // Factory method to create a register variable location
    public static OperandLocation fromRegisterVariable(String name) {
        return new OperandLocation(LocationType.REGISTER, name);
    }

    // Check if the location is an immediate value
    public boolean isImmediate() {
        return this.type == LocationType.IMMEDIATE;
    }

    // Check if the location is a memory location
    public boolean isMemory() {
        return this.type == LocationType.MEMORY;
    }

    // Check if the location is a global variable location
    public boolean isGlobal() {
        return this.type == LocationType.GLOBAL;
    }

    // Check if the location is a register variable location
    public boolean isRegister() {
        return this.type == LocationType.REGISTER;
    }
}

package ra;

import org.bytedeco.llvm.LLVM.LLVMValueRef;

public interface RegisterAllocator {
    // Allocates registers for the given function.
    public int allocate(LLVMValueRef function);

    // Resolves the location of an operand.
    public OperandLocation resolveOperand(LLVMValueRef operand);
}

// Maintain survival variable intervals
public class Interval {
    private int startPoint;
    private int endPoint;

        this.startPoint = startPoint;
        this.endPoint = endPoint;
        this.llvmValueRef = llvmValueRef;
    }

    public int getStartPoint() {
        return this.startPoint;

Antlr4 知识

隐藏通道

注意

这里对于 Lab2 题目的理解有问题，使用隐藏通道的本意就是保证代码格式和输入一样，但是第三项的任务就是代码格式化。所以第二项代码高亮中不需要保证代码格式一样，它会在第三项中使用相关代码来进行格式化，对于空白符直接进行-> skip即可。因此这里将处于 Lab2 的记录转移到 antlr4 的额外知识处来，学习相关操作。

对于空白符的处理，我们是不进行代码高亮的，但是需要保持源代码的格式，所以我们需要捕获这个空白符。之前我们都是通过-> skip直接丢弃，这里需要采用-> channel(HIDDEN)将空白符传入隐藏通道，这样我们才可以进行捕获。但是这里的捕获是对于词法层次而言的，一旦通过SysYParser sysYParser = new SysYParser(tokens);将 tokens 传给了词法分析器，那么这个隐藏通道的数据就丢失了。所以我们需要将 tokens 越过词法分析器，直接传递给MyVisitor，之后在MyVisitor中进行隐藏通道的处理。

下面代码展示了部分Main.java对于隐藏通道数据处理的代码，可以看到在通过词法分析获取的 tokens 中存在隐藏通道的数据。但是这里一旦传递给SysYParser后，隐藏通道就消失了。因此这里就只能将词法分析得到的 tokens 间接通过new MyVisitor(tokens)传递给MyVisitor来保留隐藏通道的数据。

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        ......
        // 词法分析
        SysYLexer sysYLexer = new SysYLexer(input);
        CommonTokenStream tokens = new CommonTokenStream(sysYLexer);

        // 打印所有Token，包括隐藏通道
        tokens.fill(); // 填充所有Token
        for (Token token : tokens.getTokens()) {
            if (token.getChannel() == Token.HIDDEN_CHANNEL) {
                System.out.print(token.getText()); // 直接打印隐藏通道中的Token文本
            }
            else {
                System.out.print(token.getText()); // 打印Token文本
            }
        }

        // 语法分析
        SysYParser sysYParser = new SysYParser(tokens);
        SysYParser.ProgramContext tree = sysYParser.program();

        // 访问语法树
        MyVisitor visitor = new MyVisitor(tokens); // 传入 tokens
        visitor.visit(tree);
    }
}

下面是MyVisitor.java的部分代码，主要是关于包含隐藏通道的 tokens 传递和代码高亮处理。对于隐藏通道数据而言，这里获取了从词法分析拿到的所有 tokens，然后根据当前 Token 的位置信息currentTokenIndex来判断什么时候输出空白符，其余情况下就对语法分析后的 tokens 进行处理，由此分割开了隐藏通道的数据，使其可以被输出，也就使代码格式和源代码相同了。另外对于语法分析后的 tokens，在applyColorAndPrint进行代码高亮处理。通过判断 tokenType 来对于终结符进行处理，而对于更高层的语法分析，下面的语法分析部分会进行阐述。

public class MyVisitor extends SysYParserBaseVisitor<Void> {
    ......
    private final BufferedTokenStream tokens;
    private int currentTokenIndex = 0; // 用于追踪当前Token的位置

    public MyVisitor(BufferedTokenStream tokens) {
        this.tokens = tokens;
    }

    @Override
    public Void visitTerminal(TerminalNode node) {
        Token token = node.getSymbol();

        // 打印隐藏通道的Token直到当前Token
        while (currentTokenIndex < tokens.size()
                && tokens.get(currentTokenIndex).getTokenIndex() < token.getTokenIndex()) {
            Token currentToken = tokens.get(currentTokenIndex);
            if (currentToken.getChannel() == Token.HIDDEN_CHANNEL) {
                System.out.print(currentToken.getText()); // 打印隐藏通道的Token
            }
            currentTokenIndex++;
        }

        // 对当前终端节点Token进行着色处理并打印
        applyColorAndPrint(node, token);
        currentTokenIndex++; // 移动到下一个Token
        return null;
    }

    private void applyColorAndPrint(TerminalNode node, Token token) {
        String tokenText = token.getText();
        int tokenType = token.getType();

        if (tokenType >= 1 && tokenType <= 9) { // const,int,void,if,else,while,break,continue,return -> LightCyan
            System.out.print(SGR_Name.LightCyan.getEscapeCode() + tokenText + SGR_Name.Reset.getEscapeCode());
        }
        ......
    }
}
